measurement_scopes.execution: Release binaries; native stdio RPC, private synthetic state, original controller retained for seeding and measurement.
measurement_scopes.throughput: sum(successful measured calls) / sum(wire_window_seconds); not arithmetic mean of round rates
measurement_scopes.interval_cpu: 1000 * sum(/proc measured CPU deltas) / sum(successful measured calls)
measurement_scopes.whole_child_cpu: actual child lifetime CPU including startup, 32 seeds, 16 warmups, measurement and shutdown; not measurement-only CPU
measurement_scopes.rss: median of actual wait4 whole-lifetime max_rss_kib; /proc RSS before/after values remain endpoints and are never relabeled as peaks
measurement_scopes.retained_state: 32 successful host_list requests seed each controller; original seed bytes are reported unchanged. Reads also create audit records, so this is not a constant-size 32-record audit archive.
measurement_scopes.latency_scope: No global percentile or statistically significant tail-latency claim is made.
measurement_scopes.verification_boundary: Recomputed from the downloaded report; raw calls.jsonl, wire files and retained before/after maps were not separately available to this local analysis, so their reported hashes/byte comparisons are not independently re-read here.

investigation_flags.rule: Per concurrency, investigate if the SAME primary threshold is exceeded in both ABBA blocks: throughput change < -5%, measured CPU/request > +10%, or median wait4 maxRSS > +10%; whole wait4 CPU threshold also reported separately.
investigation_flags.threshold_interpretation: Investigation flags only; neither absence nor presence is automatic acceptance or statistical significance.

verification.planned_design: 2 blocks x 2 tools x C1/C4/C8 x A/B/B/A
verification.verification_boundary: All checks recomputed from the supplied report and its per-request records. Referenced remote binary/source/raw-wire/artifact files were not downloaded or independently rehashed in this task; their recorded pins and byte counts were checked for internal consistency, not represented as new external verification.

timing_boundary_observation.interpretation: All reported measurement spans are slightly larger than last measured response minus first measured request sent timestamp. This is consistent with an outer measurement timestamp taken immediately before submission, but that outer timestamp is not separately stored in this report and the harness source was not provided for this analysis. Both reported-span and raw-request-span pooled rates are retained. The difference is at most 13.414 microseconds / 0.0065% per controller and does not alter any engineering flag. It is not silently treated as exact equality.

measurement_scopes.throughput: four waves, first tool submission through last tool response; no continuation
measurement_scopes.throughput_formula: Primary: sum(successful measured tool calls) / sum(reported measurement.seconds), independently recomputed from all attempts. Sensitivity: same calls divided by sum(last decoded measured response minus first sent measured request). Neither uses arithmetic averages of controller rates.
measurement_scopes.latency: request write through complete JSON-RPC decode; validation happens afterward
measurement_scopes.latency_quantiles: All measured requests included; median and nearest-rank p95. No p99/significance claim from small samples.
measurement_scopes.resource: original child wait4 lifetime RSS KiB and CPU including initialize, ping, continuation, shutdown
measurement_scopes.cpu_per_call: sum(wait4 user+system CPU for entire original children) / sum(measured inventory calls). Includes initialize, all pings, continuation where applicable, and shutdown; not CPU of inventory scans alone.

interval_proc_resources.reason: The supplied attempt schema has no before/after /proc CPU or RSS snapshots. No interval CPU delta or isolated scan RSS can be computed.

measurement_scopes.rss: Actual per-controller wait4 ru_maxrss in KiB; median/range/max over original controllers, not RSS samples or peak during measured interval only.
measurement_scopes.rss_floor_observation: 40/48 wait4 maxRSS observations are exactly 28000 KiB. This is a plateau in the reported whole-child high-water metric; the report does not identify its source, and equality does not prove identical scan allocation.
measurement_scopes.page: first page always rescans; one continuation is validated outside measured calls; per-state namespace hash
measurement_scopes.cache: fresh controller/state per cell; identical full sorted receipt read/hash warming
measurement_scopes.pings: 20 ms target during tool waves; actual dispatch lag retained; no catch-up bursts
measurement_scopes.input_identity: Fresh private namespace per controller; page snapshot/cursor hashes are namespace-bound and therefore intentionally differ across controllers. Legacy text results and underlying receipt-content manifests are identical.

investigation_flags.rule: Investigate only when the same matched tool/C metric in both blocks has throughput decrease >5%, or whole-child CPU/call or median wait4 maxRSS increase >10%. This is an engineering investigation threshold, not automatic adoption or statistical significance.

limits: Only matched tool/concurrency cells are compared. No mixed-tool or mixed-concurrency throughput or global latency percentile is exported.
All negative and mixed block results are retained, including process_list_page C8 whole-child median wait4 maxRSS growth.
Whole-child CPU includes initialization, pings, continuation checks, and shutdown; scan-only CPU is not available.
The threshold is a prompt for investigation, not an automatic acceptance rule.

measurement_scopes.execution: Optimized dev test profile (opt-level 1, debug info disabled); fixed command construction plus owned copy; excludes SSH, runtime policy digest preparation, and end-to-end RPC.
measurement_scopes.time: Sum of wall nanoseconds divided by sum of operations within each matched component/worker/arm cell.
measurement_scopes.parallelism: At four or eight workers, wall time per operation is amortized across concurrent workers; it is not individual request latency.

metrics.aggregate_rate_scope: Descriptive candidate-only rate for this fixed C8 soak; no baseline soak comparison or overall speedup is implied.

measurement_scopes.workload: Six immutable synthetic outputs, each 44-48 bytes, exercised using file_info and binary_read; pool enabled, tracing disabled.
measurement_scopes.throughput: Original per-cell successful calls divided by original per-cell seconds; all four complete file rounds retained. No heterogeneous overall speedup is computed.
measurement_scopes.cpu: Reported per-cell CPU and separately reported waited process-tree CPU are retained. Resource coverage is the original controller and observed local descendants; remote CPU is excluded.
measurement_scopes.rss: Native controller/tree RSS and high-water values are sampled maxima. They are not complete observed-process lifetime peaks; incomplete samples can miss short-lived descendants.
measurement_scopes.sampling_errors: All resource observation errors are retained: 1, 2, 0, 5 in the four file rounds and 21 in the candidate soak. Successful workload completion does not remove those sampling gaps.
measurement_scopes.latency: Only original per-cell latency quantiles and the range of soak cell p95 values are exported; no global p95, p99 significance, or percentiles obtained by averaging cell percentiles.
measurement_scopes.provenance: Native stage metrics and assertions are selected from the complete composed native report. The original stage report hashes are reported provenance; this export does not replace an independent raw-stage analysis.

file_abba_resource_sampling_errors.kind: PermissionError reading /proc/<pid>/fd; original errors retained in all_rounds.shutdown.resources.errors.
file_abba_resource_sampling_errors.counting: Final per-round lists counted once; cumulative cell snapshots not summed.

independent_native_analysis.file_latency_scope: Only reported cell p50/p95/p99 are local, without measured per-call timestamps. File latency boundaries cannot independently be rederived here and are not server-only service time. P95 ranges describe two reported 96-call cells per arm, not pooled percentiles.

method.counts: round-robin counts differ by at most one; identical tool/page sequence in all four rounds
method.cpu: measured /proc process ticks plus actual wait4 for complete round; no successful subset
method.data: native owner, IDs and timestamps are fresh each round; identical count/schema and validated complete original projections, not byte-identical cross-arm fixtures
method.latency: single send to full received JSON-RPC line, before response logging/validation
method.limits: one ABBA block; no cold, large-scale, concurrent, multi-host, failure-recovery or statistical speedup qualification

small_archive.latency_method: Nearest-rank p95/p99 recomputed from every embedded measured call. Send to full received JSON-RPC line, before logging/validation. Throughput uses original wall interval, also including client inter-call work.
small_archive.resource_scope: Measured /proc controller CPU is a 100 Hz tick interval. Actual wait4 CPU/maxRSS cover the whole original controller and any descendants it reaped. After-measured /proc RSS is a separate point observation.

pipe_expected_business_outcomes.interpretation: Seven canary expectations passed: four succeeded and three conservative effect_unknown outcomes. Two drain deadlines and one drain cancel report exit 125, output_complete=false and output_durable=false. Do not describe all seven jobs as succeeded. Native response payloads outside the embedded case evidence are remote receipts only.

locally_verified: SHA and length of ten copied original reports plus main lease; full report hash chain.
All four file ABBA rounds and all 27 soak cells retained; pooled throughput recomputed.
4096 embedded small-archive measured call IDs, timings, success flags and latency statistics.
190 embedded base64 file-receipt occurrences decoded and rehashed; job IDs, launch nonce, witnesses, single-execution markers, fixture identity, outputs and stdin cross-checked.
not_independently_available_locally: Remote file/soak measured calls.jsonl and per-call latency: cannot independently reaggregate global p95 or measured request uniqueness against wire bytes.
Raw stdio wire, SSH logs, controller-record bytes, artifact manifests and hostload sample files remain at remote recorded paths; their receipts are not local original-byte hashes.
Live state after the reports and physical remote process/filesystem observation.
Original compiler inputs/binaries and historical file helper are not reexecuted or exhaustively reread by this analysis.
verification_boundary.sampling_limit: 0.1 s local-tree sampling can miss peaks or short-lived processes. /proc fd PermissionError remains disclosed; sampled values are not actual wait4 maxRSS or guaranteed bounds.
verification_boundary.statistical_limit: One short native ABBA block, two cells per arm per concurrency. No significance or confidence interval. A two-block investigation rule from another experiment cannot be applied as if native had two blocks.

engineering_conclusion.support: Eight stages and both leases completed once and reaped their original helper children; scoped pipe expectations and six-host same-original recovery are consistent with embedded evidence.
engineering_conclusion.performance: File native throughput is mixed: C1 -1.856%, C4 -0.927%, C8 +0.385%. Small-archive C1 +4.137% is descriptive. Retention may be supported alongside full qualification evidence, but no general release throughput speedup is established.
negative_findings_retained: Candidate file C1 throughput and reported CPU/call worse; both candidate C1 cell p95 values exceed both baseline p95 values.
Candidate file C4 pooled throughput slightly lower.
Candidate median cumulative sampled tree RSS higher, from only two whole-round observations per arm.
Soak iteration 19 has p95 1006.921 ms and 17.907 calls/s and is included in every total.
Final resource error lists: file ABBA 8, soak 21, recovery shutdown 1. Errors are retained; cumulative repeats are not counted as new failures.
Three pipe cases intentionally terminate effect_unknown.

Small-archive pooled throughput and mean latency improve, but usage_stats and request_history p95 are slightly higher; request_history p99 and request_archive maximum latency are also higher. All raw calls and these adverse tail observations are retained.
engineering_conclusion.adoption_claim: No automatic performance-adoption or statistical-significance claim; use the full already-qualified change review.

report.hash_provenance: recorded in the main lease completion event

main_lease.scope: The main lease and each native stage report single-attempt original-child custody through wait/reap. This is bounded-run cleanup evidence; it does not establish recovery after supervisor or host destruction.

interpretation_limits: All successes, failures, original attempts, and mixed or negative block comparisons present in the cited analyses are retained; no round is discarded for being slow.
Ordinary retained-result throughput decreases at C1 and C8 remain visible, as do mixed inventory results and page C8 RSS growth.
The repeated-block thresholds are engineering investigation flags, not automatic acceptance or claims of statistical significance.
The component benchmark uses an optimized development/test build at opt-level 1 with debug information disabled. Component speed ratios are not release/RPC or multi-host speedups.
The native file test supplies one complete ABBA block; the candidate C8 soak is 120 configured seconds, with 122.09651202335954 seconds summed over measured cells.
Actual whole-child wait4 maximum RSS, point-in-time RSS endpoints, and sampled native process-tree maxima retain separate labels and scopes.
No global optimum, overall acceleration, global latency percentile, production-owner failover, power-loss durability, reboot recovery, or general WAN behavior is established.
